item.title: Tan Boon Khai to lead Therme Group as CEO
item.description: Therme Group has appointed Tan Boon Khai as CEO of Therme Group Singapore. He will lead the development of Therme Singapore at Marina South as part of the group’s expansion in Asia. Tan has more than 30 years of experience across the public and private sectors in Singapore. He was previously CEO of JTC Corporation.
